name: Making PDFs
summary: Turn your own data into a PDF somebody can download — an invoice, a receipt, a report.

provenance.changes: Written for the Shipyard starter stack, using pdf-lib so it runs anywhere Node does with no native dependency to install.

extensionPoints.description: Your documents. This one is an example — change it or add your own beside it.

postInstall: Serve the bytes with Content-Type: application/pdf and a Content-Disposition filename, or the browser shows it instead of saving it.
limitations: Text and tables. No images, no charts, no custom fonts — the built-in fonts cover Latin alphabets only, so this cannot set Greek, Cyrillic, Arabic or CJK text.
It does not do the arithmetic for you beyond totalling the lines you give it. What VAT applies is your decision and your accountant's.
An invoice produced here is not automatically a legal invoice. What has to appear on one differs by country.
solves: let people download a receipt as a pdf
produce a report as a pdf
create a printable document from data
